$schema_note: Plain JSON spec for an implementing LLM. Not JSON Schema. Read llm_contract first. Greenfield: there is no production database and no data to migrate.

llm_contract.role: Implement only the changes listed in `changes` whose `status` is `approved` and whose `layer` is in `execution.allowed_layers`.
rules: There is no production. Do not RENAME lists/cards. Do not backfill. Do not run orphan preflights.
Treat this file as the source of truth. Canvases are human views of the same plan.
Apply changes in `wave` order. Inside a wave, respect `depends_on`.
Wave 0 replaces the existing TypeORM migrations with one baseline that CREATE TABLE using the names in `target_schema`.
Do not invent extra tables, columns, enums, or product features beyond this file.
Do not rewrite services except items with layer=app that are approved.
Postgres + TypeORM. Partial unique indexes are the uniqueness mechanism for live/active rows.
Do not use CONCURRENTLY inside a transactional TypeORM migration.
After implementing, set that change status to implemented only if the user asked to update this file.

target.strategy: Replace InitialSchema + AddScalabilityIndexes + AddSprints with a single baseline migration. Drop the old migration files. Empty database assumed; `typeorm migration:run` on a fresh DB is the only path.

context.product: Levity — workspace (tenant) with N boards; kanban + optional sprint overlay per board
context.why: Baseline schema in final names. Workspace is not a board. No production dump to patch.

identity_glossary.username: Stable login handle. Unique among live users. register/login, JWT, @mentions. Not in profile PATCH.
identity_glossary.first_name: Given name. Optional. Editable on profile.
identity_glossary.display_label: Not a column. Compose concat_ws(' ', first_name, last_name) or username.
identity_glossary.email: Optional unique contact among live users. Not the login key.
identity_glossary.account_status: ENUM users_account_status_enum: active | suspended. Login only if active AND deleted_at IS NULL.
identity_glossary.deleted_at: Tombstone. Live uniques ignore these rows.
identity_glossary.last_login_at: Last successful token issue (login and register).

workspace_glossary.workspaces.status: ENUM workspace_status_enum: active | archived. Default active.
workspace_glossary.workspace_members.role: ENUM workspace_role_enum: owner | admin | member. Tenant ACL only. Not board editor/viewer.
workspace_glossary.workspace_members.last_accessed_at: Last open of the workspace home.

board_glossary.boards: Kanban container. N per workspace. Create workspace inserts the first board.
board_glossary.board_members.role: ENUM board_role_enum: admin | editor | viewer. Source of truth for seeing/editing that board.
board_glossary.sprints.board_id: One active sprint per board (partial unique).
board_glossary.home_list: Boards the user has board_members for. Workspace owner/admin may self-grant. Creating a board auto-inserts board_members admin for the creator.
board_glossary.invite: workspace_invites + invite_board_grants. Grants required (≥1 board). Accept upserts workspace_members then board_members. Snapshot of current boards if UI checks “all current”; no inherit-future-boards.

catalog_glossary.priority_system: Four system rows per workspace: code low|medium|high|critical, name LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL, is_system=true. Custom extras allowed. New issues default MEDIUM (app). System rows cannot be deleted.
catalog_glossary.tag: workspace_tags + issues.tag_id uuid NULL. Option A locked. UI may say Label. No issue_tags M2M. No workspace_labels.
catalog_glossary.status: catalog_status_enum: active | archived on tags and priorities.

naming_locked.issues.content: Title of the issue. Do not rename to title in this spec.
naming_locked.board_columns.title: Column header. Keep.
naming_locked.workspace_tags: Keep. issues.tag_id. Rejected: workspace_labels, label_id, issue_tags.

do_not: Do not mention or create tables named lists, cards, card_history, sprint_cards, comments, diagrams.
Do not RENAME; there is nothing to rename. CREATE the target names.
Do not keep users.display_name. Columns are first_name + last_name.
Do not name workspace_members.role with editor|viewer — those are board_role_enum.
Do not put board ACL only on invite JSON. Persist invite_board_grants and board_members.
Do not use sprints.workspace_id. Sprint is per board.
Do not use board_columns.workspace_id. Column is per board.
Do not store issues.priority or issues.label as varchar.
Do not rename workspace_tags. Do not add issue_tags or label_id.
Do not omit the four system priorities. Do not default issue priority_id to NULL.
Do not inherit future boards on invite. Do not accept an invite with zero board grants.
Do not add workspace_id denormalized on issues (reach workspace via column → board).
Do not enable WRITE_ROLES / wip_limit enforcement here (layer=app deferred).
Do not drop column_type or progress; they diverge until product.done_definition.
Do not add issues.deleted_at until product.soft_delete_issues is approved. Hard DELETE is fine.
Do not modify files storage / cover_url semantics.
Do not use CONCURRENTLY in a TypeORM transaction migration.
Do not add users.status. Use account_status + deleted_at.
Do not add workspaces.status=deleted. Tombstone is deleted_at.
Do not table-UNIQUE (workspace_id, name) on tags/priorities — use live partial unique (active + deleted_at IS NULL).
Do not table-UNIQUE workspace_members (workspace_id, user_id) for all rows — unique only among membership_status=active.
Do not duplicate UNIQUE with a second btree on the same columns (no IDX_workspace_members_workspace_user).

create_workspace_transaction: INSERT four board_columns (todo, in_progress, review, done) — app wave; baseline may omit seed SQL

changes.acceptance: Fresh migrate creates only target_schema.tables. No lists/cards. Partial uniques exist. FKs on issue_diagrams, notifications, assignee, priority_id, tag_id.

changes.intent: Entities/DTOs/routes match baseline names. Create workspace transaction. Invite grants. Board ACL.
rules: Entities: Board, BoardMember, BoardColumn, Issue, IssueEvent, IssueComment, IssueDiagram, SprintIssue. No Card/List types.
JSON: column_id, issue_id, priority_id, tag_id, board_id, workspace_role, board_role.
createWorkspace: single transaction — WS, owner member, 4 system priorities, first board, default columns, board_members admin.
createIssue: priority_id required or default MEDIUM of that workspace; tag_id optional same workspace.
assertBoardMember for board reads; board_role editor|admin for writes. Workspace viewer does not exist — viewer is board_role.
Invite: require ≥1 invite_board_grants. Accept: workspace_members + board_members. Conditional UPDATE on current_uses < max_uses.
completeSprint in one transaction. One active sprint per board (DB already unique).
Settings catalog: deleted_at not DELETE. Refuse delete of is_system priorities.
Home boards: WHERE board_members.membership_status=active. Owner/admin of WS may self-grant.
changes.acceptance: API compiles without Card/List. New workspace has 1 board and 4 priorities. Invite without grants is 400.
